final_tests_independently_rerun.includes: Ancestor-symlink rejection,fdopen pre-adoption cleanup and after-close primary-exception preservation.

names: 100 repeated successful verifications with unchanged fd count
same-inode content write then original bytes restored rejected in observed run

findings.issue: Entry-only canonical-path check allowed an intermediate ancestor to become a symlink while reading. Final root.stat(follow_symlinks=False) protected only final component.
findings.actual_reproducer: Under a tiny temporary tree,parent/archive/capture.bf16 was16B. Guard3 renamed parent to moved and symlinked parent->moved. Original file inode/stat and bytes remained equal; original bridge returned complete=True despite root.resolve()!=root.
findings.impact_limit: Canonical/no-symlink path stability gap,not file-byte or inode forgery.
findings.fix: Root repeats root.resolve()==root before final directory acceptance. Source-inspected; independently rerun regression now rejects.

findings.issue: Injected fdopen pre-adoption OSError left a newly opened fd unclosed;original finally covered directory only. Probe count5->6;reviewer closed its leaked test fd.
findings.counterevidence: Actual CPython fdopen on a directory already closes its input and raises IsADirectoryError;no leak before patch (chunk1d25a6). This was a pre-adoption fault seam,not an ordinary directory-error leak.
findings.fix: On construction exception root attempts close(fd),tolerates OSError if fdopen already closed it,and bare-raises original exception. Independently rerun tests cover both pre-adoption and after-close faults;primary error preserved rather than EBADF masking.

additional_scope_observation.topic: Mode is not included in five-field identity
additional_scope_observation.observed: Actual chmod0664->0764 in guard3 left ctime_ns unchanged on this filesystem. Five-field identity and bytes remained equal and verification accepted.
additional_scope_observation.assessment: Not a declared-contract defect:owned regular single-link and five-field identity are required,not fixed0600 or permission-history freezing. Root confirmed this scope.
additional_scope_observation.probe_correction: Supplementary chmod probes incorrectly assumed ctime must change and failed their own assertions (chunksc9c210,a0db6f). Separate stat probe established actual filesystem behavior. These failures are not product test failures; no chmod-rejection claim is made.

acceptance_basis: Known complete extent<=max before opening. File identity binds dev/ino/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns; actual file must be current-uid-owned,regular and single-link. Name opened relative to owned directory fd with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK.

BoundedReader checks initial offset0,sequential tell==consumed,positive requests<=65536,declared extent and EOF. Unchanged pinned verifier checks finite bytes,full tensor/whole hashes,original controls and selected rows.

After byte verification,guard and fd/path stats repeated,then final canonical path and original directory dev/ino. Final18 tests and targeted extra probes support source acceptance within these boundaries.
limitations: Before/after filesystem observations are not an atomic namespace snapshot or protection against mutation after return. Serial guard/lease and actual producer exit remain external. Timestamp equality does not establish complete mutation history.
Caller authenticates producer identity,old cases,new archive metadata,source/weights and exit. Bridge explicitly does not establish runtime admission or source/exit provenance.
One-file bridge only;future independent admitted reviewer must bind all6 cases/18 archives,resource bounds and persisted review results. No native runner/reviewer execution accepted.
